subject.title: fix(agy): suppress tool use and file links in print-mode summaries

question: Should text-only Antigravity calls reserve 173 argv characters or bytes for the suppression directive, causing formerly near-limit prompts to fail early in exchange for cleaner output?
rationale: The patch handles the new effective limit correctly, but accepting the small compatibility change in maximum prompt capacity is a repository-owner judgment rather than a correctness question.

options.title: Accept the capacity tradeoff
options.body: Merge the focused fix with the documented reduction because clean text-only output is more valuable than preserving the final 173 units of an already constrained argv path.

options.title: Wait for native enforcement
options.body: Pause the PR until Antigravity provides a hard no-tools or text-only control that does not consume prompt capacity.

recommendation.title: Accept the capacity tradeoff
recommendation.body: Merge the focused fix with the documented reduction because clean text-only output is more valuable than preserving the final 173 units of an already constrained argv path.

likelyOwner.reason: The remaining choice concerns repository compatibility policy and merge acceptance rather than implementation ownership.
